title: watch: bootstrap failure falls back to s-0, replays all historical messages as notifications
description: In cmd_watch (watch.rs:642), if the bootstrap Message/get fails, last_message_state is set to "s-0" (beginning of time). The next SSE state event will then trigger Message/changes since s-0, returning all historical messages, and fire desktop notifications for every message ever received. The fallback should be to exit with an error, not silently proceed with a broken baseline.
